issue: strategy A and B are not on the same footing

subset_relationship.note: B uses the first 200 of the same FIN#### draw, so the units overlap; the estimator set and the calibration regime do not

calibration_frame_count_correction.explanation: the non-quick path takes 9 calibration distances; the '5' in the report is the quick-mode value, so the cost of strategy B was understated by 80%

invalid_gain_quote.quoted: recalibration is worth roughly 1.5 mm (baseline) to 3 mm (robust)
invalid_gain_quote.why: subtracting a 200-assembly single-estimator number from a 2000-assembly three-estimator number mixes populations; the per-estimator A value for gaussian_2d_integrated is the only legitimate comparison point, and even then the assembly count and failure denominators still differ

legitimate_comparison_available.caveat: still not a paired test: B covers 200 of the 2000 assemblies. A paired A/B bootstrap on the 200 shared assemblies with the same estimator is the minimum honest comparison, and that re-run is budget-bound
legitimate_comparison_available.paired_rerun_reason: strategy B on 200 assemblies x 7 distances x 1 estimator took ~4 minutes per candidate during the original run; G3 does not re-execute it

required_disclosure: any A/B table shows N=2000/3 estimators and N=200/1 estimator side by side
